title: Fine-joint information beyond reach phase

titles: Mouse M1/S1 reaching and grasping calcium, 3D kinematics and M1 inactivation

scientific_question: How accurately can predictions using permitted M1/S1 calcium and context improve held-out joint angles over an independently fixed target/phase/coarse-motion model, and how does prediction gain vary between areas within the same five mice?
primary_outputs: Actual held-out 24-joint trajectories establish prediction losses; the signed incremental EV and paired S1-minus-M1 contrasts are recomputed from those measurements and submitted predictions, never supplied by a favored paper conclusion.

data_manifest.file_count_scope: Top-level published assets, including code/docs where packaged together; not a participant count.
data_manifest.subject_count_evidence: Author archive description and pinned docs/SUMMARY.md. Optogenetic recordings use two additional named mouse files; not pooled with the imaging cohort.

recording_contract.neural: Trial R structs contain events and hasNeuralData; eventLockData returns time × ROI data. Raw/denoised calcium and RADICaL-derived variants are distinct allowed-input choices, not interchangeable raw spikes.
recording_contract.labels: R/M sources yield 3D marker positions and 24 joint angles/velocities, LR reach target and event intervals. Optogenetic trial labels are available for a separate behavioral intervention task.
recording_contract.time_alignment: Pinned eventLockData subtracts syncTime from event timestamps, aligns frameTimes using cycleDurMs and corrects ROILags. tPts and cycleDurMs use milliseconds; resampling to 10 ms does not create 100 Hz independent observations.
recording_contract.biological_ids: Imaging mice cfa17,cfa19,cfa20,cfa22,cfa24; two dated sessions per mouse, M1 and S1 per docs. R(1).animalID and timestamped filenames provide grouping. Separate optogenetic files cfaVG1/cfaVG4.
recording_contract.evidence: Published 13-file inventory; pinned loadData, eventLockData, loadLock4Decode, decode and SUMMARY inspected. Data schema comes from author source, not loaded MAT structures.

primary.name: equal_mouse_area_joint_fixed_nuisance_incremental_EV
primary.aggregation: Implemented additive scorer pools each session joint query SSE/SST across all five folds once; ΔEV=(SSE_operator_fixed_nuisance−SSE_candidate_prediction)/SST, equal24 joints, two areas per mouse and five mice, retaining all signed values.
primary.rationale: Recorded angles are the target and independently frozen nuisance predictions are the comparison anchor. Candidate nuisance degradation cannot raise the primary. Arbitrary permitted methods are allowed; closeness to the fixed analysis is only a separate legacy calibration endpoint.

secondary: All240 per-joint gains, candidate and fixed nuisance/neural/shifted MSEs, candidate/nuisance R² and signed fixed-reference comparisons.
Five mouse-level gains and descriptive S1−M1 differences; the new scorer supplies no inferential interval or p-value.

Matched candidate context-only and neural-disruption ablations under equal fitting/selection budgets are required separately before attributing gain to neural observations. The fixed shifted reference is not a matched arbitrary-candidate ablation.
Unchanged legacy reconstruction MAE and historical sign-flip/t95/Holm diagnostics remain calibration-only outputs, never silently combined with the new primary.

comparators.name: Fixed nuisance ridge
comparators.inputs: Identical public z, training angles and no calcium.
comparators.procedure: Existing mean-loss ridge alpha1 with training standardization/intercept becomes a separately frozen operator comparator; candidate may not redefine it.

comparators.name: Fixed residualized calcium reference
comparators.inputs: Same x/z/training angles and fixed128-ROI budget.
comparators.procedure: Current reference residualizes neural activity and angles against z, fits training PCA explaining90% residual variance and ridge; use as a fixed declared reference whose empirical competence remains unqualified, not a mandatory candidate algorithm.

comparators.name: Whole-training-trial shifted neural reference
comparators.inputs: Same complete inputs with neural training trials rotated within reach-target strata.
comparators.procedure: Current floor(n/2) cyclic rotation and refit preserve phase/target composition; diagnostic rather than a unique causal test.

evaluation.uncertainty: Five mice, not50 folds or240 joint effects, are biological units. New measured-target scorer reports complete descriptive mouse/area values without intervals or significance. Legacy32 sign-flip/t95/Holm outputs retain their own historical assumptions and are not new-score inference.
evaluation.failure_policy: Require exact50-case identity, complete ordered query trials and every51×24 trajectory. New candidate schema needs trial_id and neural predictions only; legacy3-arm artifacts are compatible, but their nuisance/shifted values cannot affect the primary. Undefined joint variance or arithmetic overflow/underflow refuses the complete score. CLI requires independently supplied operator design/binding hashes and pinned target/reference arrays.
